name: 2D Texture-Based Volume Rendering
definition: A GPU rendering method where volumetric data is stored in 2D texture images, projected onto the image plane as object-aligned slices, and blended back-to-front.
summary: 2D Texture-Based Volume Rendering decomposes volumetric data into parallel 2D slices stored in texture maps, enabling real-time visualization on hardware lacking 3D texture support by using hardware-accelerated bilinear interpolation.
